mapper.sql:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'ACTION' AS taskType, a.action_run_id AS taskId, a.instance_id AS instanceId, i.title AS instanceTitle, i.definition_id AS definitionId, i.definition_version_id AS definitionVersionId, n.node_run_id AS nodeRunId, n.node_key AS nodeKey, n.round_no AS roundNo, a.action_key AS actionKey, n.activated_time AS waitingSince FROM t_workflow_action_run a JOIN t_workflow_node_run n ON n.node_run_id = a.node_run_id JOIN t_workflow_instance i ON i.instance_id = a.instance_id WHERE a.assignee_id = #{accountId} AND a.status = 'PENDING' AND (n.status = 'ACTIVE' OR (n.status = 'APPROVING' AND a.required = 0)) AND i.status = 'RUNNING' UNION ALL SELECT 'APPROVAL', p.approval_id, p.instance_id, i.title, i.definition_id, i.definition_version_id, n.node_run_id, n.node_key, n.round_no, NULL, p.create_time FROM t_workflow_approval p JOIN t_workflow_node_run n ON n.node_run_id = p.node_run_id JOIN t_workflow_instance i ON i.instance_id = p.instance_id WHERE p.approver_id = #{accountId} AND p.status = 'PENDING' AND n.status = 'APPROVING' AND i.status = 'RUNNING' ) t
AND t.taskType = #{taskType} AND t.instanceTitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!'
mapper.select: ORDER BY waitingSince DESC, taskId DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'ACTION' AS taskType, a.action_run_id AS taskId, a.instance_id AS instanceId, i.title AS instanceTitle, i.definition_id AS definitionId, i.definition_version_id AS definitionVersionId, n.node_key AS nodeKey, n.round_no AS roundNo, a.action_key AS actionKey, a.status AS result, a.submitted_time AS handledTime, i.status AS instanceStatus FROM t_workflow_action_run a JOIN t_workflow_node_run n ON n.node_run_id = a.node_run_id JOIN t_workflow_instance i ON i.instance_id = a.instance_id WHERE a.submitted_by = #{accountId} AND a.submitted_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'APPROVAL', p.approval_id, p.instance_id, i.title, i.definition_id, i.definition_version_id, n.node_key, n.round_no, NULL, p.status, p.decided_time, i.status FROM t_workflow_approval p JOIN t_workflow_node_run n ON n.node_run_id = p.node_run_id JOIN t_workflow_instance i ON i.instance_id = p.instance_id WHERE p.approver_id = #{accountId} AND p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RETURNED', 'REJECTED') ) t
AND t.taskType = #{taskType} AND t.instanceTitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!'
mapper.select: ORDER BY handledTime DESC, taskId DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT instance_id AS instanceId, node_key AS nodeKey, round_no AS roundNo, status FROM t_workflow_node_run WHERE node_type = 'TASK' AND instance_id IN #{id}

SELECT n.instance_id AS instanceId, n.node_key AS nodeKey, n.status AS nodeStatus, a.assignee_id AS userId FROM t_workflow_node_run n JOIN t_workflow_action_run a ON a.node_run_id = n.node_run_id AND a.status = 'PENDING' WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.instance_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT n.instance_id, n.node_key, n.status, p.approver_id FROM t_workflow_node_run n JOIN t_workflow_approval p ON p.node_run_id = n.node_run_id AND p.status = 'PENDING' WHERE n.status = 'APPROVING' AND n.instance_id IN #{id}

SELECT v.definition_version_id AS definitionVersionId, v.definition_id AS definitionId, d.definition_code AS definitionCode, d.definition_name AS definitionName, v.version_no AS versionNo, (d.current_version_no = v.version_no) AS currentVersion, v.action_snapshot_json AS actionSnapshotJson, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_workflow_instance i WHERE i.definition_version_id = v.definition_version_id AND i.status = 'RUNNING') AS runningInstanceCount FROM t_workflow_definition_version v JOIN t_workflow_definition d ON d.definition_id = v.definition_id WHERE v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.action_snapshot_json LIKE CONCAT('%"', #{templateId}, '"%') ORDER BY d.definition_code, v.version_no DESC

SELECT t.template_id AS templateId, COUNT(DISTINCT d.definition_id) AS definitionCount FROM t_workflow_definition d JOIN t_workflow_definition_version v ON v.definition_id = d.definition_id AND v.version_no = d.current_version_no JOIN JSON_TABLE(v.action_snapshot_json, '$.templates[*]' COLUMNS (template_id VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.templateId')) t WHERE v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.template_id IN #{id} GROUP BY t.template_id
